title: Dragon Portal Wagon Ride
description: A dramatic fantasy scene shows a blue dragon warrior with white wings and sword standing beside a red Radio Flyer wagon labeled 'RADIO FLYER'. Inside the wagon sits a bearded man holding a small house model. A blonde woman in a black dress pulls the wagon while another blonde woman emerges from a swirling purple and orange magical portal framed by stone ruins. A massive black dragon with glowing blue eyes flies above amid lightning and falling pink petals.
